# 0026. Role calls are owed on counts read from task records, and a dated call clears them whatever it says

Date: 2026-10-20

## Status

Accepted

## Context

`role_triggers.py` owed a chief-engineer call on a `- Cycle N` line under `### Feedback Cycles` and cleared a call only when its question named `Cycle 3` or `Amendment N`. Over 38 window tasks in four repositories it read 0 events in the two that record cycles in stage-report headings, and it refused 3 of the 4 calls FO had made (two worded "third repair cycle", one filed under another heading). The Captain's direction on 2026-10-20 was counts from structured records, not keywords. The measurement, the per-task table and the falsified alternatives are in the task's `## Design`. This supersedes the wording-match clause of the special-role-triggers design (PR #664), which has no ADR of its own to amend.

## Decision

**Words:** 「設計時不應該過度依賴關鍵字，而是可能要依靠犯錯字數觸發，合理嗎？」 — Captain, 2026-10-20, chat; 「先加第一個，第二個列入評估」 — Captain, 2026-10-20, chat, on the engineering-reviewer model rule and the security-reviewer evaluation; at the ideation gate, 2026-10-20, D1 「同意」, D2 「第四輪」, D3 「Ａ」, D4 「Ａ」, D5 「同意」, each as the gate question recommended.

**Options considered:**
- Chief-engineer is owed at four repair passes, read as `## Stage Report: implementation` headings minus one (chosen, D2); three passes fires one more false case (go-live-consent); a sent-back count added one case and needs a free-text verdict match that leaves 105 of 410 validation reports unreadable; same-path review rounds, holds or overrides, ADR-draft headings and cross-references added no unique true catch or false-fired
- Engineering-reviewer keeps its replacing-amendment event, one line per task, cleared by a call dated no earlier than the amendment on a model no lower than the one required, or by a dated waiver (chosen)
- Model: Fable when the frontmatter says `profile: prod` or the `Surfaces:` line lists `db`, else Opus, never lower (chosen, D4); path or secret signals were not chosen (the authority-path signal marks 31 of 38 tasks, secrets have no field)
- Review rounds, two review ids with inline findings on an open task PR, also owe chief-engineer, as a last separate slice (chosen, D1)
- The four engineering-reviewer cases no count sees stay with judgment and no `Reverses:` line is added (chosen, D3)
- ADR 0021 D1 stays: stage 1 of the evaluation reads saved reports and runs no model, stage 2 waits for its result (chosen, D5)

**Recommended:** each of D1 to D5 as the gate question stated, which the Captain accepted.

A call or a waiver counts only as a `Reviewer:` line under `## FO alignment`, and a call counts by its date and model, not by its question. Later work that changes what owes a role call reads counts from committed task records and does not match phrases.

## Consequences

FO is told once per task and role, in the line `pr_watch.py tasks` already prints, until the call is recorded. A call on another question dated after an amendment now clears it. A count cannot see an authority change, a ruling reversed in another task or a new authority surface; those stay with the Captain and FO. The thresholds are in-sample on one 38-task window judged by four observers. Reopen when a batch shows an owed case the count missed twice in the same shape, or a false fire on a task whose extra passes were phases.

Amended 2026-10-22 (Captain: 「可以」 at the ideation gate of the task `merge-ask-holds-missing-clauses`, narrowing it to this one hold; 「按建議**不算**」 on D2): `delivery_gate.py check` runs `role_triggers.py` on the task folder and stem, without `--review-rounds`, and holds the merge ask while the committed task owes a chief-engineer call (four repair passes) or an engineering-reviewer call (a replacing amendment): exit 1 adds one problem line and the script's `next:` lines, exit 2 holds with its message (「可以」). Review rounds do not hold the ask; idle still prints that call (「按建議不算」). The script reads the task as committed, so an amendment not yet state-committed is not seen and a call not yet state-committed does not clear. "Told once per task and role" above still describes the idle line; a skipped call now also refuses the merge ask until the call or a dated waiver is committed.

Amended 2026-10-25 (Captain: 「都開」 on 2026-10-23 and 「可以」 on 2026-10-25 for the task `role-triggers-owe-ce-on-review-drift`; 「全准」 at its ideation gate on 2026-10-25, accepting D1 and D2 as the gate question recommended): a review-round event is cleared only by a chief-engineer call or waiver dated no earlier than the UTC date of the newest review round, which `pr_watch.py tasks` reads from the one comment list it already fetches and passes as `--drift-date`; a call about something else made before that round no longer clears it, and no file-path test is used (D1). A call made earlier on the same date as that round still clears it. Without `--drift-date` any call or waiver clears, as before; the repair-pass event keeps its undated clear. The merge ask still does not count review rounds (D2).

Amended 2026-11-02: Astra meets the Fable floor, and chief-engineer calls need opus rank or above, for both repair-pass and review-round events. The date and waiver rules stay as recorded above; see ADR 0049 for the Captain's words and the accepted model table.

Amended 2026-11-02 (Captain: 「可以」, answering 「決定：多開「完成通知」和「挑剔使用者可用 Gemini」兩張票，先前五件事照建議，可以嗎？」 at the ideation revision of `second-round-prompts-a-step-back`; then 「照建議」, answering 「決定：五張設計進實作、Gemini 這張停在這裡，四個決定都照建議嗎？要改哪件直接說。」 at its ideation approval): two validation reports with a Material or Needs decision F bullet, or two amendments whose `Supersedes:` does not start with `none`, print the three questions at idle and merge without a hold. The counts stay separate. D1 follows this record's structured-count rule and ADR 0045's F-bullet form, accepting that 5 of 13 word-detected tasks stay silent; replacing amendments count, not every relaxation. At either count's third occurrence, D2 follows the repair/amendment merge hold and existing waiver, rather than review rounds' non-hold; D3 assigns chief-engineer because an engineering-reviewer call already clears amendments whatever its question. Its one owed line carries: is what I am solving still the outcome first asked for; can this gap be tested now, or am I waiting; what breaks if this criterion or process is deleted? The opus-rank floor applies, Astra included. A call or waiver dated no earlier than the third amendment clears that event, reusing the drift-date rule; any qualifying call or waiver clears failed validations, reusing the undated repair rule. A fourth occurrence owes no second call; engineering-reviewer's amendment event stays separate. At count two, questions repeat on each run without an answer record; at three or more, a cleared event prints no reminder.

Amended 2026-11-02 (Captain: 「照建議」, answering 「決定：四件事都照建議嗎？要改哪件直接說。」 after FO proposed 「修這兩個 bug，在原本的票裡修」, recorded in `second-round-prompts-a-step-back` Captain amendment 1): each count reaches its own reminder threshold independently. A cleared event at three or more does not suppress the other event's second-occurrence reminder. Suppress a duplicate reminder only when an emitted owed-call line already carries the three questions; all model, date, waiver and merge-hold rules above remain.

Amended 2026-11-03 (Captain: 「可以」, answering 「決定：七張設計照建議進實作，但驗收到期提醒的 D7 改成『在 kc-journey-map 登記 journey-progress/v1，預算放寬為兩個 PR，kc-journey-map 那個先合併』，可以嗎？」 at the ideation gate of `diagnosis-rounds-count-toward-step-back`, accepting its D1 and D2 as recommended): dispatch records count diagnosis rounds by stage and normalized `Symptom:` header, trimming and collapsing spaces and casefolding; values starting with `none`, fenced lines and body lines do not count. At round two, `dispatch_records.py` prints the three step-back questions on stderr before each dispatch, following ADR 0027's placement at the write; folder mode checks each stage's highest-numbered record, and `--names` counts only through the named record. A record numbered two or higher without the header gets a stderr hint; only `--names --strict` holds it (D1). Idle and merge read committed records: round two advises without a hold, round three owes chief-engineer and holds the merge ask (D2). An opus-rank-or-above call or waiver under `## FO alignment`, dated no earlier than the third record's first `Dispatched:` date, clears that symptom's later rounds too; without that date any qualifying call or waiver clears. Other event families remain independent; an owed line carrying the questions suppresses duplicate reminders. With the replay's symptom name, measured added words are 48 per dispatch reminder, 21 per missing-header hint, 47 at idle/merge round two and 74 at round three; a clean dispatch, startup, after archive and the workflow template add zero. The workflow word budget is unchanged. Renamed symptoms and multiple browser runs inside one dispatch remain outside the count.

Clarified 2026-11-03 (Captain: 「照你建議」, answering 「決定：B 照原設計修，讓追加指示紀錄也算進同症狀的輪數嗎？」, Captain amendment 1 of `diagnosis-rounds-count-toward-step-back`, superseding no criterion): a supported `<stage>-N-message-M.md` follow-up is a dispatch round on its own symptom, as the approved design states. Both disk and committed-state readers count it; record number, then message number, gives numeric order, with the plain record before its messages. The third counted record dates clearing whether it is plain or a follow-up.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise dispatch records through the real Spacedock binary in split-root repos."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import uuid

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WRAPPER = ROOT / "scripts/dispatch_stage.py"
CHECKER = ROOT / "scripts/dispatch_records.py"
BINARY = os.environ.get("SPACEDOCK_BIN")


class DispatchStageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dispatch-stage-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(temporary.name).resolve()
        self.repo = self.base / "code"
        self.workflow = self.repo / "docs/dev2"
        self.workflow.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.slug = "dispatch-fixture-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.addCleanup(self.remove_artifacts)
        self.env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                    if key not in ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE", "GIT_COMMON_DIR")}
        self.env.update(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="Dispatch Fixture", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="Dispatch Fixture",
                        GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fixture@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="fixture@example.invalid",
                        GIT_CONFIG_COUNT="2", GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0="commit.gpgsign", GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="false",
                        GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1="core.hooksPath", GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="/dev/null", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        (self.workflow / "README.md").write_bytes((ROOT / "references/sd/workflow.md").read_bytes())
        (self.repo / ".gitignore").write_text(".worktrees/\n**/.spacedock-state/\n")
        self.call(["git", "init", "--initial-branch=main", self.repo])
        self.git(self.repo, "add", "--", ".gitignore", "docs/dev2/README.md")
        self.git(self.repo, "commit", "-m", "test: workflow")
        self.state = self.workflow / ".spacedock-state"
        self.git(self.repo, "worktree", "add", "--detach", self.state)
        self.git(self.state, "checkout", "--orphan", "spacedock-state/dev2")
        self.git(self.state, "rm", "-rf", ".")
        self.entity = self.state / f"{self.slug}.md"
        self.entity.write_text("---\ntitle: Synthetic dispatch\nvariant: kc-dev-flow-2\nprofile: pilot\n"
                               "status: ideation\n---\n\n## FO alignment\n\nSurfaces: none\nVisible change: none\n")
        self.commit_task()
        self.folder = self.state / self.slug
        self.checklist = self.base / "checklist.txt"
        self.checklist.write_text("Inspect the real dispatch seam\nKeep the received second checklist line\n")
        self.notes = self.base / "notes.txt"
        self.notes.write_text(f"Package root: {ROOT}\nSend your completion message to `main`.\n"
                              "Keep this second scope-notes line verbatim.\n")
        self.spy = self.base / "spy"
        self.marker = self.base / "called"
        self.spy.write_text(f"#!{sys.executable}\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport subprocess, sys\n"
                            f"Path({str(self.marker)!r}).write_text('called')\n"
                            f"sys.exit(subprocess.call([{BINARY!r}, *sys.argv[1:]]))\n")
        self.spy.chmod(0o755)

    def remove_artifacts(self):
        for path in Path("/tmp/spacedock-dispatch").glob(f"*{self.slug}*"):
            if path.is_file():
                path.unlink()

    def call(self, args, expected=0, child_env=None, data=None):
        result = subprocess.run(list(map(str, args)), cwd=self.base, env=child_env or self.env,
                                input=data, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        if os.environ.get("DISPATCH_STAGE_LOG"):
            with Path(os.environ["DISPATCH_STAGE_LOG"]).open("a") as log:
                log.write(json.dumps(dict(argv=list(map(str, args)), exit=result.returncode,
                                          stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)) + "\n")
        if expected is not None:
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, expected, (args, result.stdout, result.stderr))
        return result

    def git(self, root, *args):
        return self.call(["git", "--literal-pathspecs", "-C", root, *args]).stdout.strip()

    def commit_task(self):
        self.git(self.state, "add", "--", self.entity.relative_to(self.state))
        self.git(self.state, "commit", "-m", "test: task")

    def set_stage(self, stage):
        self.entity.write_text(self.entity.read_text().replace("status: ideation", f"status: {stage}"))
        self.commit_task()

    def build(self, stage="ideation", extra=(), expected=0, cleanup_spy=False, child_env=None):
        launch = [sys.executable, "-B", WRAPPER]
        if cleanup_spy:
            script = ("import sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv.pop(1)); "
                      "import dispatch_stage as subject; original = subject.remove_uncommitted; "
                      "marker = Path(sys.argv.pop(1)); "
                      "subject.remove_uncommitted = lambda *a: (marker.write_text('called'), original(*a))[1]; "
                      "sys.exit(subject.main())")
            launch = [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", script, WRAPPER.parent, self.base / "cleanup-called"]
        return self.call([*launch, "--workflow-dir", self.workflow,
                          "--entity-path", self.entity, "--stage", stage, "--model", "fixture-model",
                          "--checklist-file", self.checklist, "--scope-notes-file", self.notes,
                          "--spacedock", BINARY, "--host", "codex", *extra], expected, child_env)

    def record(self, stage="ideation", number=1):
        return self.folder / "dispatch" / f"{stage}-{number}.md"

    def assert_committed(self, path, subject):
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "log", "-1", "--format=%s", "--", path), subject)
        root = Path(self.git(self.state, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"))
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "show", f"HEAD:{path.relative_to(root)}"), path.read_text().strip())
        self.assertEqual(self.git(self.state, "status", "--porcelain", "--", path), "")

    def test_stamp_commits_complete_record_and_exact_inputs(self):
        dispatched = self.git(self.workflow, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        result = self.build(extra=("--roster", "fixture roster", "--note", "README fixture"))
        envelope = json.loads(result.stdout)
        record = self.record()
        self.assert_committed(record, f"dispatch: {self.slug} entering ideation")
        self.call([sys.executable, "-B", CHECKER, self.folder])
        self.call([sys.executable, "-B", CHECKER, "--names", "--strict", record])
        text = record.read_text()
        self.assertIn(f"Dispatched: {dispatched} (workflow checkout, README fixture)", text)
        self.assertIn("Model: fixture-model\nRoster: fixture roster", text)
        received = Path(envelope["dispatch_file_path"]).read_text()
        for heading, source in (("Checklist", self.checklist), ("Scope notes", self.notes)):
            section = text.split(f"## {heading}\n", 1)[1].split("\n## ", 1)[0]
            for line in source.read_text().splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    self.assertIn(line, section)
                    self.assertIn(line, received)

    def test_incomplete_record_does_not_build_or_change_state(self):
        self.notes.write_text("Send your completion message to `main`.\n")
        head, task = self.git(self.state, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), self.entity.read_bytes()
        held = self.build(extra=("--spacedock", self.spy), expected=1)

content.content:
# 0070. Stage worker dispatches are built by a package script that writes their record

Date: 2026-11-07

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Three sessions left dispatch records late, reconstructed or incomplete: the
kc-paseo-plugins batch r1b-polish-1 reconstructed its records after dispatch;
the qnow observer found an unrecorded addendum; the kc-plugin observers found
late and incomplete records in batches 14 and 15. The task
`dispatch-build-writes-the-dispatch-record` records those sources.

Spacedock 0.27.2 writes the dispatch artifact but not the task's dispatch record.
It has no dispatch hook and does not read the model roster. Its stamp commit
already includes the task folder, providing a seam for a package-owned writer.
ADR 0014 keeps the package and workflow preflight checks separate, and ADR 0027
places structured write checks at the write.

## Decision

**Words:** 「核准（建議）」 — Captain, host question dialog, 2026-11-07,
batch 17 ideation approval. The question's dispatch-record excerpt was
「派工紀錄 D1 用套件裡的派工腳本並新增一份決策紀錄（ADR）、D2 模型與名冊仍由我手填、D3 版本與工作流程檢查這次不併進腳本」;
it specified 「核准即接受每張設計對其決定寫下的建議。要改哪件直接說。」.
Source: the task's ideation gate resolution, attempt 1, recorded at
2026-11-07T15:37:23.875685Z on `spacedock-state/dev2`.

**Options considered:**
- Build through a package script that writes and checks the dispatch record,
  leaving Spacedock unchanged (chosen).
- Change upstream Spacedock: outside this package; no dispatch hook exists at
  the pinned version.
- Resolve model and roster inside the script: not chosen; retain FO-supplied flags.
- Include package-version and workflow-checkout checks: not chosen; retain their
  existing separate commands and Captain-facing holds.

**Recommended:** the package script, FO-supplied model and roster, and separate
package-version and workflow-checkout checks, as accepted by the Captain.

**Protects:**
- `kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/dispatch_stage.py` — `main`, the write/check/build order

FO builds stage-worker dispatches with `dispatch_stage.py`. It writes the record
from the build's checklist and scope-notes inputs, adds the supplied model and
workflow-checkout SHA, checks it, then builds. The stamp commit carries the record;
reuse-advance dispatches use `spacedock state commit` before returning the envelope.
Model and roster remain FO-supplied. The two pre-dispatch checks remain separate.

## Consequences

Record writing no longer depends on a separate manual step when FO uses the
script. This remains prose-enforced: Spacedock's skill still names its own
builder, and a direct call bypasses the writer. `dispatch_records.py --coverage`
still holds missing records after a worker report. Follow-up messages remain
manually recorded. A real-binary split-root test checks the stamp's commit seam.
Reopen on ADR 0014's condition: a dispatch-time hook in Spacedock.
